title: EFC — Master Specification
abstract: Formal master specification of Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC), defining the dynamical energy-flow field, an effective potential coupled to entropy, an entropy-modulated expansion rate, and an entropy-dependent effective light speed. The paper unifies rotation curves, lensing behavior, and late-time acceleration as emergent thermodynamic effects without invoking non-baryonic dark matter or an external dark-energy component.
